summary.text: Mitch Little is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 65 who has represented the district since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Mitch Little earned a bachelor's degree from Harvard University and a law degree from the University of Texas, and his career experience includes working as an attorney.
He has served as a member of Sojourn Church.
Little took office on January 14, 2025, succeeding Kronda Thimesch.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Detrick Deburr in the general election.
